test(apk-0232 r1): the logon-screen desktop pick through the product shared session -- fake host and a real pre-login host

client_session_prelogin_select_test (product session + the APK's gate, fake control host): local pick, IDR lost then
delivered, deferred before the first Pong, window picks refused (direct and queued), ordinary host and UAC+LockCred
keep the ack path, stale ops, repeat pick, reconnect -- 38/38. The session as it was at 5970f04: 14 FAIL. Mutants:
G1 bind at Admit -> 1 FAIL, G2 deltas pass while unbound -> 2 FAIL, S2 local path for secure desktop too -> 2 FAIL.

viewer_prelogin_login_e2e_test --android-select: the shared session at a REAL pre-login host (first Pong 3 s late):
the pick queued before the role, gone local, completed by the host's own IDR (panel selected with its generation,
first output), nothing rejected, link up; a second pick local at once with a new IDR; a window pick refused.

Product / test / docs: product (none) / test (new session test, pre-login e2e mode, CMake target) / docs (none).
